The structure is described in a nonstandard input cell with lattice parameters a = 5.02608422 Å, b = 6.082960000000001 Å, c = 6.68326618 Å, α = 117.06936493000002°, β = 102.97141533999998°, and γ = 89.99847659999999°, containing 14 atoms with the declared composition Na₂V₄O₈. The underlying symmetry is space group number 15, C2/c (Hall symbol −C 2yc), and the conventional standard fractional coordinates q_standard are obtained from the input fractional coordinates q_input through q_standard = P q_input + s, where the first row of P is (3.168965197060732×10⁻¹⁸, −1.5237248141085692×10⁻¹⁸, −0.49999999999999994), the second row is (−3.168965197060732×10⁻¹⁸, −1.0, 0.49999999999999994), the third row is (−1.0, −5.6939469619484865×10⁻¹⁸, −1.1550426341664848×10⁻¹⁸), and the origin shift s is (1.4999999999876223×10⁻⁶, −1.4999999999876223×10⁻⁶, 0.0). Input positional values were rounded to six decimal places before the listed corrections.

In the standard C2/c description, sodium occupies the single fourfold 4e orbit with coordinate relation (0, y, 1/4); its representative site is (0.0, 0.301013, 0.25), so the only independent positional parameter is y = 0.301013. Vanadium occupies one general 8f orbit with representative position (0.24667700000000004, 0.3674210000000002, 0.762067), giving independent parameters x = 0.24667700000000004, y = 0.3674210000000002, and z = 0.762067. Oxygen is split between two crystallographically independent general 8f orbits. The first oxygen orbit has representative (0.1536169999999999, 0.3803660000000002, 0.026658999999999988), with independent parameters x = 0.1536169999999999, y = 0.3803660000000002, and z = 0.026658999999999988. The second oxygen orbit has representative (0.16450049999999994, 0.1201175000000001, 0.525439), with independent parameters x = 0.16450049999999994, y = 0.1201175000000001, and z = 0.525439. These four orbits account for the full standard-cell content through their multiplicities: four Na, eight V, and sixteen O atoms in the conventional C-centered cell, while the supplied primitive-like input cell contains two Na, four V, and eight O atoms.
